targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(t.name), ''), 'Untitled') AS "✈️ Trip",
  t.started_at AS "📅 Start",
  t.ended_at AS "📅 End",
  ROUND(convert_distance(d.distance_m / 1609.344)::numeric, 1) AS "📏 Distance",
  ROUND((d.energy_used_wh / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "⚡ Drive Energy",
  ROUND((c.energy_added_wh / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "🔌 Charged Energy",
  ROUND(c.cost_decimal::numeric, 2) AS "💰 Charge Cost",
  c.currency AS "Currency",
  d.drive_count AS "🛣️ Drives",
  c.charge_count AS "⚡ Charges",
  ROUND(convert_efficiency(
    d.energy_used_wh / NULLIF(d.distance_m / 1609.344, 0)
  )::numeric, 1) AS "⚡ Efficiency"
FROM trips t
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS drive_count,
    SUM(dr.distance_m) AS distance_m,
    SUM(dr.energy_used_wh) AS energy_used_wh
  FROM trip_drives td
  JOIN drives dr ON dr.id = td.drive_id
  WHERE td.trip_id = t.id
) d ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS charge_count,
    SUM(cs.total_energy_added_wh) AS energy_added_wh,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE cs.cost_decimal IS NOT NULL
          AND NULLIF(BTRIM(cs.cost_currency::text), '') IS NULL
      ) = 0
       AND COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(BTRIM(cs.cost_currency::text), '')) = 1
        THEN SUM(cs.cost_decimal)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cost_decimal,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(BTRIM(cs.cost_currency::text), '')) = 1
        THEN MIN(NULLIF(BTRIM(cs.cost_currency::text), ''))
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(BTRIM(cs.cost_currency::text), '')) > 1
        THEN 'Mixed'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS currency
  FROM charging_sessions cs
  WHERE cs.vehicle_id = t.vehicle_id
    AND cs.started_at >= t.started_at
    AND cs.started_at <= COALESCE(t.ended_at, NOW())
) c ON TRUE
WHERE t.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
  AND $__timeFilter(t.started_at)
ORDER BY t.started_at DESC
LIMIT 50
